safety_subtitle: Breath-hold and freediving training carries real risk. Please read this before continuing.
safety_point_no_solo: Never practice breath-holding in water alone — always train with a buddy who can help.
safety_point_no_hyperventilate: Do not hyperventilate before a breath-hold. It can mask warning signs your body needs to breathe.
safety_point_stop_if_unwell: Stop immediately if you feel dizzy, lightheaded, or unwell in any way.
safety_point_not_medical_advice: Deeply is a training tool, not medical advice. It does not diagnose, treat, or guarantee your safety.
safety_acknowledge: I understand and will follow these safety guidelines.
